items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: when the Pope died, the whole trip was cancelled.

ctx.x: Olympia. And then we went on down to Holland, and we stayed -- oh, they had everything set up for us, and then when the Pope died, the whole trip was cancelled. And the rest of the fellows went back to Paris to wait for the boat, and I took a plane from Holland, Amsterdam, come on back to New York. By the time they got back here, I was working, you know.
And then they got another show that fall to go to
